name: Texas Grill
address: Meade St, George Central, George, 6530, South Africa
description_short: American-style steakhouse in George Central serving flame-grilled steaks, ribs, and burgers since 1996.
description_long:
Texas Grill has been a George fixture since 1996, bringing American steakhouse flavours to the Garden Route. The menu centres on flame-grilled steaks, sticky pork ribs, and generous burgers, with portions that don't hold back. The atmosphere leans casual and family-friendly, with a sports bar vibe that makes it popular for group gatherings and weeknight dinners.

Located on Meade Street in George Central, it's a convenient spot whether you're passing through or looking for a reliable meal in town. The prices sit comfortably in the mid-range, and the focus is squarely on hearty, no-fuss grills. If you're after a proper steak or ribs without the fine-dining formality, this is where locals head.
